title: Pullback-compatible completed-to-native coefficient maps
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite-dimensional coefficient field E over Q_ℓ with an embedding into the algebraic closure, and a NativeGeometry. There exist a family of ring maps from the completed integral coefficient system to the native coefficient system, compatible with inverse image along every scheme morphism, together with a normalized CoefficientPresentation at every scheme representing each map.

lean.statement:
theorem native_completed_coefficient_change_data [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] PadicAlgCl l) :
    ∃ (m : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
        (PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring T ⟶ (nativeCoefficients l).ring T)
      (C : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, CoefficientPresentation l T E i),
      (∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V),
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull g).hom ≫ m U =
          (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map (m V) ≫
            ((nativeCoefficients l).pull g).hom) ∧
      (∀ T : Scheme.{u}, m T = (C T).integralMap l T)
